relationship_description: Feliciano Belmonte is the father of Joy Belmonte, both prominent members of the Belmonte political dynasty in Quezon City.
Evelio Leonardia, Mayor of Bacolod, is married to Carmelita Leonardia, both associated with the Leonardia political family in Negros Occidental.
Erlpe John Amante and Angelica Amante are siblings, both part of the Amante political dynasty in Agusan del Norte.
